column1: V2 + fallback25 remains slightly stronger on overall accuracy: +0.32 percentage points end-to-end, +2.55 points conditional, and +0.34 points on equal-weight requirement accuracy. Sol nevertheless produced verdicts for 55 more cases and achieved 15 more requirements with every case correct. Its main weakness is safety-oriented: Sol produced 337 false accepts versus 108 for V2, although it produced far fewer false rejects (92 versus 259). Therefore Sol is broader and less restrictive, while V2 is slightly more accurate overall and substantially more conservative against invalid cases.

Metric separation note: pipeline acceptance, artifact availability, conditional RDF accuracy, end-to-end RDF accuracy, manual semantic fidelity, and manual code quality are different measurements and must not be presented as the same result.
